# WhoIs agent · Identity & Memory Suite (whois-agent)

> One install that answers **who your agent is**, remembers everything across sessions, verifies its identity, and registers every output. A lifecycle-anchored suite over 8 LGD-governed sub-skills: Register → Remember → Verify → Output → Evolve.

`whois-agent` is an Agent Skill collection. It references 8 sub-skills by slug and copies none of their implementations — they are published independently on the public model registry. Bilingual (English-first / 中文).

## Core

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/whois-agent/blob/main/SKILL.md): skill main file (YAML frontmatter + read_when triggers)
- [README.md](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/whois-agent/blob/main/README.md): pipeline diagram, sub-skill index, install matrix, evidence bars
- [scripts/whois_route.py](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/whois-agent/blob/main/scripts/whois_route.py): route a request to the right sub-skill slug
- [references/subpackage-index.md](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/whois-agent/blob/main/references/subpackage-index.md): slug index and where each sub-skill installs

## Install

- [install.sh](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/whois-agent/blob/main/install.sh): one-shot installer (macOS / Linux)
- [install.ps1](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/whois-agent/blob/main/install.ps1): one-shot installer (Windows PowerShell)
- [package.json](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/whois-agent/blob/main/package.json): package metadata (name / version / author / license / keywords)

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/whois-agent/blob/main/AGENTS.md): working guide for AI agents
- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/whois-agent/blob/main/llms-full.txt): full text for long-context models
